_about: GENERATED from RFI canon by tools/convert-5e.mjs (rubric v1.8.1) — do not hand-edit; put fixes in content/overrides/callings.json. The NPC callings (trade + trick per tier) as dnd5e monster feats.

description.value:
"Somebody has to stand where the trouble is."

Bravo is the Strength Calling — the trade that kept its bearers alive after the Shattering. Umbrella: guard, soldier, bandit, bouncer, duelist, caravan outrider. A profession is a flavor label on the Calling.

Knack — Shieldwall: Allies within reach add +1 AC (+2 at Tier III). The Bravo is why the militia line holds.

Skill kit: signature: melee attack rolls (proficient); secondary: melee attack rolls (proficient).

Services: a standard job costs the tier fee (T1 10 / T2 30 / T3 90 / T4 270 marks), paid in Strength marks. Cross-pool ×1.5 friction applies as usual.

Tiers: Apprentice → Initiate → Master → Archon. Grant the matching tier features alongside this class item.

Awakens into: Aurablade or Bulwark. A character is a Calling that ignited into a Path — Surge is the mark of Stewardship, which is why no Calling banks or spends it.

Bravo — Apprentice (Tier I).

Trade — Stand a watch: AC a person, door, or camp for a night/shift. Standard fee 10 marks (Strength).

Trick — Hold the Line (1/short rest): When an adjacent ally is hit, the Bravo takes the hit instead.

Bravo — Archon (Tier IV).

Trade — Raise the wall: Marshal a settlement's defense; the hex counts one bracket tougher for one raid (GM adjudicates). Standard fee 270 marks (Strength).

Trick — Last Stand (1/short rest): When an ally within reach would drop to 0 hit points, the Bravo intercepts, takes the damage, and makes one immediate free strike.

Bravo — Initiate (Tier II).

Trade — Drill the green: Train a group; they count as proficient in one Strength skill for the next scene that tests it. Standard fee 30 marks (Strength).

Trick — Disarming Blow (1/short rest): On a hit, the target drops its weapon or takes −2 on its next strike.

Bravo — Master (Tier III).

Trade — Muscle for the job: Accompany one operation as a combatant (full stat participation). Standard fee 90 marks (Strength).

Trick — Veteran's Read (1/short rest): Declare one enemy's next move aloud; all allies get +2 to defend against exactly that.

Master step: the Bravo's Knack (Shieldwall) improves at this tier — see the class entry.

"There is no problem two reasonable parties can't monetize."

Broker is the Charisma Calling — the trade that kept its bearers alive after the Shattering. Umbrella: merchant, envoy, entertainer, cult recruiter, gang face. A profession is a flavor label on the Calling.

Knack — Fair Price: The Broker moves any negotiated price 5% per tier in their side's favor inside the ±25% tolerance band (Tier IV: the full ±20% swing).

Skill kit: signature skill Persuasion: proficient at Tier I, expertise from Tier II; secondary Insight: proficient from Tier II, expertise from Tier III.

Services: a standard job costs the tier fee (T1 10 / T2 30 / T3 90 / T4 270 marks), paid in Diplomacy or Soft Power (GM picks by job) marks. Cross-pool ×1.5 friction applies as usual.

Tiers: Apprentice → Initiate → Master → Archon. Grant the matching tier features alongside this class item.

Awakens into: Harmony Marshal. A character is a Calling that ignited into a Path — Surge is the mark of Stewardship, which is why no Calling banks or spends it.

Broker — Apprentice (Tier I).

Trade — Word on the street: Current prices, current rumors, who's buying. Standard fee 10 marks (Diplomacy or Soft Power (GM picks by job)).

Trick — Read the Room (1/short rest): GM truthfully answers: who here has the real power, and what do they want right now?

Broker — Archon (Tier IV).

Trade — The table: Convene a parley between hostile parties who would not otherwise sit. Standard fee 270 marks (Diplomacy or Soft Power (GM picks by job)).

Trick — Deal of a Lifetime (1/short rest): Mid-scene, produce terms both sides prefer to violence; fighting stops while the offer stands.

Broker — Initiate (Tier II).

Trade — An introduction: Arrange a meeting with someone one social rung up. Standard fee 30 marks (Diplomacy or Soft Power (GM picks by job)).

Trick — Crowd's Ear (1/short rest): Sway a crowd's disposition one step (hostile→wary, wary→listening).

Broker — Master (Tier III).

Trade — Shape the story: Seed or smother one rumor across a settlement over a downtime. Standard fee 90 marks (Diplomacy or Soft Power (GM picks by job)).

Trick — Name-Drop (1/short rest): Invoke a connection to open one door; the GM decides what string comes attached.

Master step: the Broker's Knack (Fair Price) improves at this tier — see the class entry.

"The dead are fine. It's the living who need tending."

Keeper is the Wisdom Calling — the trade that kept its bearers alive after the Shattering. Umbrella: priest, ritualist, medium, hedge-warden, funeral speaker. A profession is a flavor label on the Calling.

Knack — Hearthlight: Allies within near range add +1 Resolve (+2 at Tier III). The congregation stands straighter when the Keeper is present.

Skill kit: signature skill Religion: proficient at Tier I, expertise from Tier II; secondary Insight: proficient from Tier II, expertise from Tier III.

Services: a standard job costs the tier fee (T1 10 / T2 30 / T3 90 / T4 270 marks), paid in Soft Power marks. Cross-pool ×1.5 friction applies as usual.

Tiers: Apprentice → Initiate → Master → Archon. Grant the matching tier features alongside this class item.

Awakens into: Pactkeeper or Dreamwalker. A character is a Calling that ignited into a Path — Surge is the mark of Stewardship, which is why no Calling banks or spends it.

Keeper — Apprentice (Tier I).

Trade — The rites: Weddings, funerals, blessings; participants recover 2×tier Stress between scenes. Standard fee 10 marks (Soft Power).

Trick — Steady the Wisdom (1/short rest): An ally rerolls a failed Resolve defense or immediately shakes a fear effect.

Keeper — Archon (Tier IV).

Trade — Read the omens: One divination-grade answer per downtime — a true sign about a chosen course, delivered as an omen, not a sentence. Standard fee 270 marks (Soft Power).

Trick — Intercession (1/short rest): An ally under the Keeper's care who would drop to 0 Stress holds at 1; the Keeper visibly carries it for them.

Keeper — Initiate (Tier II).

Trade — Hear the burden: One confession/counsel session clears one fear- or grief-borne condition. Standard fee 30 marks (Soft Power).

Trick — Warding Sign (1/short rest): Impose −2 on one incoming psychic or qliphothic effect.

Keeper — Master (Tier III).

Trade — Consecrate the threshold: Ward one door/room/camp — first qliphothic or psychic intrusion each encounter is blunted (−2 to its effect). Standard fee 90 marks (Soft Power).

Trick — Rite of Passage (1/short rest): End one ongoing spiritual affliction on a willing subject.

Master step: the Keeper's Knack (Hearthlight) improves at this tier — see the class entry.

"Everything's a door if you hold it right."

Operator is the Dexterity Calling — the trade that kept its bearers alive after the Shattering. Umbrella: thief, smuggler, spy, courier, fence, hacker, fixer. A profession is a flavor label on the Calling.

Knack — Underfoot: In crowds, markets, and streets, the Operator passes unremarked unless actively hunted; Streetwise checks never fumble (at Tier III, also Stealth).

Skill kit: signature skill Stealth: proficient at Tier I, expertise from Tier II; secondary Investigation (Persuasion in a town): proficient from Tier II, expertise from Tier III.

Services: a standard job costs the tier fee (T1 10 / T2 30 / T3 90 / T4 270 marks), paid in Dexterity marks. Cross-pool ×1.5 friction applies as usual.

Tiers: Apprentice → Initiate → Master → Archon. Grant the matching tier features alongside this class item.

Awakens into: Shadow Courier. A character is a Calling that ignited into a Path — Surge is the mark of Stewardship, which is why no Calling banks or spends it.

Operator — Apprentice (Tier I).

Trade — Carry it quiet: Move a package/message across town, no questions. Standard fee 10 marks (Dexterity).

Trick — Pocketed (1/short rest): Produce a mundane Tier-I item they plausibly lifted earlier.

Operator — Archon (Tier IV).

Trade — Papers, clean: Forge documents/seals good enough to pass sept or Witness scrutiny once. Standard fee 270 marks (Dexterity).

Trick — Ghost Ledger (1/short rest): One small fact of record (a manifest line, a name on a list, a shipment count) has always read the way the Operator needs it to.

Operator — Initiate (Tier II).

Trade — Fence it: Move stolen goods at ×0.30 instead of the standard fence ×0.25. Standard fee 30 marks (Dexterity).

Trick — Wasn't Me (1/short rest): After acting, vanish from the scene's notice if no one has them physically held.

Operator — Master (Tier III).

Trade — Case the place: Deliver a floor plan — entrances, watch rotations, one exploitable habit. Standard fee 90 marks (Dexterity).

Trick — Skeleton Key (1/short rest): Bypass one lock, checkpoint, or seal, offscreen-grade, no roll.

Master step: the Operator's Knack (Underfoot) improves at this tier — see the class entry.

"It's not obscure. You just haven't read it."

Savant is the Intelligence Calling — the trade that kept its bearers alive after the Shattering. Umbrella: scholar, engineer, medic, archivist, detective, translator. A profession is a flavor label on the Calling.

Knack — Library-Brain: Lore and Investigation checks never fumble; identifies items of tier ≤ own tier on sight (at Tier III, including technomagical origin).

Skill kit: signature skill History: proficient at Tier I, expertise from Tier II; secondary Investigation: proficient from Tier II, expertise from Tier III.

Services: a standard job costs the tier fee (T1 10 / T2 30 / T3 90 / T4 270 marks), paid in Economy or Soft Power (GM picks by job) marks. Cross-pool ×1.5 friction applies as usual.

Tiers: Apprentice → Initiate → Master → Archon. Grant the matching tier features alongside this class item.

Savant — Apprentice (Tier I).

Trade — Appraise / identify: What it is, what it's worth, whether it's what the seller claims. Standard fee 10 marks (Economy or Soft Power (GM picks by job)).

Trick — I've Read About This (1/short rest): Explain the situation; one ally gets +2 on their next relevant check.

Savant — Archon (Tier IV).

Trade — Draft the schematic: Author a crafting recipe for an item of tier ≤ 3 (validator rules still apply). Standard fee 270 marks (Economy or Soft Power (GM picks by job)).

Trick — Eureka (1/short rest): Solve one technical or lore obstacle outright, offscreen-grade; it simply stops being the blocker.

Savant — Initiate (Tier II).

Trade — Patch them up: Between scenes, restore 2×tier hit points to one patient or clear one physical condition. Standard fee 30 marks (Economy or Soft Power (GM picks by job)).

Trick — Diagnosis (1/short rest): Name one creature's type and reveal its resistances or a weakness.

Savant — Master (Tier III).

Trade — Research a question: One downtime, one honest answer with sources (GM: truthful, not necessarily complete). Standard fee 90 marks (Economy or Soft Power (GM picks by job)).

Trick — Field Solution (1/short rest): Jury-rig a one-use tool, antidote, or bypass from what's on hand.

Master step: the Savant's Knack (Library-Brain) improves at this tier — see the class entry.

"The Shattering didn't end the work. Nothing ends the work."

Stalwart is the Constitution Calling — the trade that kept its bearers alive after the Shattering. Umbrella: laborer, teamster, forager, wall-crew, rig-hand, survivor. A profession is a flavor label on the Calling.

Knack — Hazard-Hardened: Reduce each environmental hazard/radiation tick by 1 (by 2 at Tier III), and labor output counts double for facility/build work.

Skill kit: signature skill Athletics: proficient at Tier I, expertise from Tier II; secondary smith's tools: proficient from Tier II, expertise from Tier III.

Services: a standard job costs the tier fee (T1 10 / T2 30 / T3 90 / T4 270 marks), paid in Economy marks. Cross-pool ×1.5 friction applies as usual.

Tiers: Apprentice → Initiate → Master → Archon. Grant the matching tier features alongside this class item.

Awakens into: Bulwark or Wisdom-Smith. A character is a Calling that ignited into a Path — Surge is the mark of Stewardship, which is why no Calling banks or spends it.

Stalwart — Apprentice (Tier I).

Trade — Haul and raise: A day's heavy labor — cargo moved, wall raised, field cleared. Standard fee 10 marks (Economy).

Trick — Put Your Back Into It (1/short rest): Auto-succeed one feat of raw strength or endurance of tier-appropriate difficulty.

Stalwart — Archon (Tier IV).

Trade — Foreman: Run a work crew; a facility's output counts +1 bracket for one turn. Standard fee 270 marks (Economy).

Trick — Too Stubborn to Die (1/short rest): Damage that would drop the Stalwart leaves them at 1 hit points, still standing, immovable this round.

Stalwart — Initiate (Tier II).

Trade — Keep her running: One rig repair tick between scenes (engineer-grade maintenance). Standard fee 30 marks (Economy).

Trick — Endure (1/short rest): Halve one incoming instance of bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

Stalwart — Master (Tier III).

Trade — Guide through: Lead a party across one hex of hostile terrain, halving travel complications. Standard fee 90 marks (Economy).

Trick — Second Wind (1/short rest): Recover hit points equal to 2×tier.

Master step: the Stalwart's Knack (Hazard-Hardened) improves at this tier — see the class entry.
